items.source: Set the ConnectionFactoryLookup implementation to use for resolving connection factory name Strings in the targetConnectionFactories map.
items.translation: 将 `ConnectionFactoryLookup` 实现设置为用于解析 `targetConnectionFactories` 映射中的连接工厂名称字符串。

items.source: The mapped value can either be a corresponding ConnectionFactory instance or a connection factory name String (to be resolved via a ConnectionFactoryLookup).
items.translation: 映射值可以是相应的 ConnectionFactory 实例，或是一个连接工厂名称 String（将通过 ConnectionFactoryLookup 进行解析）。

items.source: This ConnectionFactory will be used as target if none of the keyed targetConnectionFactories match the current lookup key.
items.translation: 如果没有任何一个带键的 targetConnectionFactories 匹配 current lookup key，则使用此 ConnectionFactory 作为目标。

items.source: Default is true, accepting lookup keys without a corresponding entry in the target ConnectionFactory map - simply falling back to the default ConnectionFactory in that case.
items.translation: 默认为 `true`，接受目标 ConnectionFactory 映射中无对应条目的查找键——在这种情况下，直接回退到该 ConnectionFactory 的默认值。

items.source: Switch this flag to false if you would prefer the fallback to only apply when no lookup key was emitted. Lookup keys without a ConnectionFactory entry will then lead to an IllegalStateException.
items.translation: 将此标志切换为 `false`，如果您希望回退仅在未发出查找键时应用。没有 ConnectionFactory 条目的查找键将导致出现 IllegalStateException。

items.source: Calls to getMetadata() are routed to the default ConnectionFactory if configured.
items.translation: 对 `getMetadata()` 的调用如果已配置，则路由到`default ConnectionFactory`。

items.source: The key can be of arbitrary type; this class implements the generic lookup process only. The concrete key representation will be handled by resolveSpecifiedLookupKey(Object) and determineCurrentLookupKey().
items.translation: 键可以是任意类型；该类仅实现通用的查找过程。具体的键表示将由resolveSpecifiedLookupKey(Object)和determineCurrentLookupKey()处理。

items.source: The default implementation handles ConnectionFactory instances and connection factory names (to be resolved via a ConnectionFactoryLookup).
items.translation: 默认实现处理 `ConnectionFactory` 实例和连接工厂名称（通过 ConnectionFactoryLookup 解析）。

items.source: Allows to configure a default target ConnectionFactory as a fallback.
items.translation: 允许配置默认目标 ConnectionFactory 作为回退。

items.source: Retrieve the current target ConnectionFactory. Determines the current lookup key, performs a lookup in the targetConnectionFactories map, falls back to the specified default target ConnectionFactory if necessary.
items.translation: 获取当前的目标ConnectionFactory。确定当前查找键，在targetConnectionFactories映射中进行查找，必要时回退到指定的默认目标 ConnectionFactory。

items.source: Resolve the given lookup key object, as specified in the targetConnectionFactories map, into the actual lookup key to be used for matching with the current lookup key.
items.translation: 解析在 targetConnectionFactories 映射中指定的给定查找键对象，将其转换为用于与 current lookup key 进行匹配的实际查找键。

items.source: Delegates to initialize().
items.translation: 委托给initialize()。

items.source: Determine the current lookup key. This will typically be implemented to check a subscriber context. Allows for arbitrary keys. The returned key needs to match the stored lookup key type, as resolved by the resolveSpecifiedLookupKey(Object) method.
items.translation: 确定当前的查找键。这通常通过检查订户上下文来实现，并允许使用任意键。返回的键必须与由 `resolveSpecifiedLookupKey(Object)` 方法解析的存储查找键类型匹配。

items.source: Initialize the internal state of this AbstractRoutingConnectionFactory by resolving the configured target ConnectionFactories.
items.translation: 通过解析配置的 target ConnectionFactories 来初始化此AbstractRoutingConnectionFactory的内部状态。

items.source: Mono that emits the current ConnectionFactory as per determineCurrentLookupKey()
items.translation: 发出当前ConnectionFactory的Mono，具体依据determineCurrentLookupKey()

items.source: connectionFactory - the connection factory value object as specified in the targetConnectionFactories map
items.translation: `connectionFactory` - 在 targetConnectionFactories 映射中指定的连接工厂值对象

items.source: the resolved ConnectionFactory (never null)
items.translation: 解析后的ConnectionFactory（永远不会为null）

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if the target ConnectionFactories have not been configured
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果尚未配置目标 ConnectionFactories

items.source: Mono emitting the lookup key. May complete without emitting a value if no lookup key available
items.translation: Mono 发出查找键。如果没有可用的查找键，可能会在未发出值的情况下完成

items.source: Mark Paluch, Jens Schauder
items.translation: Mark Paluch，Jens Schauder

items.source: the lookup key as needed for matching.
items.translation: 根据匹配需要查找键。

items.source: The default implementation simply returns the given key as-is.
items.translation: 默认实现直接返回给定的键。

items.source: Specify whether to apply a lenient fallback to the default ConnectionFactory if no specific ConnectionFactory could be found for the current lookup key.
items.translation: 指定是否对当前查找键无法找到特定的 ConnectionFactory 时，对默认 ConnectionFactory 应用宽松的回退。

items.source: Retrieve the current target ConnectionFactory.
items.translation: 获取当前的目标 ConnectionFactory。

items.source: Resolve the specified connection factory object into a ConnectionFactory instance.
items.translation: 解析指定的连接工厂对象为`ConnectionFactory` 实例。

items.source: Specify the default target ConnectionFactory, if any.
items.translation: 指定默认目标 ConnectionFactory（如果有）。

items.source: Specify the map of target ConnectionFactories, with the lookup key as key.
items.translation: 指定目标 ConnectionFactories 的映射，并将查找键作为键。

items.source: Determine the current lookup key.
items.translation: 确定当前的查找键。

items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 在遇到不支持的值类型时
